doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: ValidatedStrategy base classes auto-log lifecycle events to JSONL. Log schema: timestamp, layer, event, asset, data. Enables layer-by-layer comparison.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: All log events follow standard schema with timestamp, layer, event, asset, data fields. ValidatedStrategy base classes enforce schema.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Execute rustybt and Backtrader in separate subprocesses to avoid conflicts. Never import both frameworks in same process.

doc.title: PRD
doc.snippet: FR23-FR30: Maintain identical implementations, audit for logical equivalence, execute with identical data/parameters, validate log completeness.
